mapper.select: select apr.role_code, arp.permission_code from admin_principal_roles apr left join admin_role_permissions arp on arp.role_code = apr.role_code where apr.principal_id = #{principalId} order by apr.role_code asc, arp.permission_code asc
select role_code from admin_principal_roles where principal_id = #{principalId} order by role_code asc

select distinct arp.permission_code from admin_principal_roles apr join admin_role_permissions arp on arp.role_code = apr.role_code where apr.principal_id = #{principalId} order by arp.permission_code asc

select arp.role_code, arp.permission_code, ap.description, arp.granted_at from admin_role_permissions arp join admin_permissions ap on ap.permission_code = arp.permission_code where arp.role_code = #{roleCode} order by arp.permission_code asc
select permission_code, description from admin_permissions order by permission_code asc

select r.role_code, r.description, r.created_at, arp.permission_code from admin_roles r left join admin_role_permissions arp on arp.role_code = r.role_code order by r.role_code asc, arp.permission_code asc

select p.principal_id, p.username, p.display_name, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, apr.role_code from admin_principals p left join admin_principal_roles apr on apr.principal_id = p.principal_id order by p.created_at asc, p.principal_id asc, apr.role_code asc
mapper.insert: insert into admin_principals ( principal_id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{principal.principalId}, #{principal.username}, #{principal.passwordHash}, #{principal.displayName}, #{principal.status}, #{principal.createdAt}, #{principal.updatedAt} )
insert into admin_roles (role_code, description, created_at) values (#{roleCode}, #{description}, #{createdAt}) on conflict (role_code) do nothing
insert into admin_principal_roles (principal_id, role_code, granted_at) values (#{principalId}, #{roleCode}, #{grantedAt}) on conflict (principal_id, role_code) do nothing
insert into admin_role_permissions (role_code, permission_code, granted_at) values (#{roleCode}, #{permissionCode}, #{grantedAt}) on conflict (role_code, permission_code) do nothing
